reviews.text: Not a fancy place but the nostalgia is why I go, reminds me of sneaking out of highschool to get a cheeseburger, onion rings, and a cherry lemon Sundrop.
If you grew up in this area you know those burgers taste the same as they did thirty, forty years ago!
A taste of nostalgia from my childhood.
